subject.title: fix(agents): idle-timeout stalled provider response body reads

question: Should the project accept reusing the existing TTS, native-PDF, and MiniMax request budgets as body-idle budgets while leaving all other shared-reader callers unchanged?
rationale: The patch is deliberately scoped to callers that already own a request deadline; deciding whether that rollout scope is the intended availability/compatibility policy requires maintainer judgment rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept the scoped caller-owned rollout
options.body: Keep the optional shared-reader behavior and merge the three existing-budget call sites once the current-head checks are green.

options.title: Broaden only with owner-approved budgets
options.body: Add further callers only after each owning surface identifies a compatible request or idle timeout and supplies focused proof.

options.title: Pause for a broader timeout policy
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want a repository-wide response-body deadline design instead of owner-specific wiring.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped caller-owned rollout
recommendation.body: Keep the optional shared-reader behavior and merge the three existing-budget call sites once the current-head checks are green.
